items.title: Joanne Brackeen interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 10, 2001
items.q: Tujai FiFi Tee Tai Tae was his whole name but his nickname was FiFi.

ctx.x: Now, I’m curious about those thick horn harmonies, how you got that. Because you only had two horns, but are you playing that kind of with them or something? © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-
Well that was “A Dog,” written for my dog, my little FiFi. Tujai FiFi Tee Tai Tae was his whole name but his nickname was FiFi.
What was his full name again?
